entries.choice_handling_note: Firearm Proficiency replaces Bare Knuckles and is represented by the first-level martial talent allocation. Wisdom governs Tension and the AC feature.

resources.name: Mutagen
resources.description: Track the active mutagen and its selected physical ability. Duration and greater/grand improvements use Striker level as Alchemist level.

entries.choice_handling_note: Nature is the required first sphere and Blended Training allows each later class talent to be martial or magical.

power_providers.label: Ninja Tricks in place of Striker Arts
power_providers.description: A Striker Art slot may instead hold a Ninja Trick; Master Tricks become available at 11th level.

choice_providers.label: Unethical Science
choice_providers.description: Choose an unethical invention at 1st, 3rd, and every four levels thereafter.

resources.name: Laboratories
resources.description: One laboratory at 1st level and another at levels 5, 10, 15, and 20.

choice_providers.label: Destructive Focus
choice_providers.description: The first-level magic talent must be the Destruction sphere unless it is already possessed.

resources.name: Destructive Blade
resources.description: Track the active destructive blade. It uses Mageknight level as caster level and functions as the published melee-touch blast shape.

choice_providers.label: Divine Domain
choice_providers.description: Choose one domain; use Herculean Scion level as Cleric level and casting ability modifier in place of Wisdom.

choice_providers.label: Knight's Order
choice_providers.description: Choose one Cavalier order; Knightknight levels determine its effects.

resources.name: Gallantry
resources.description: Gallantry equals practitioner modifier + one-quarter Knightknight level and substitutes for spell-point costs of class features.

resources.name: Marked for Justice
resources.description: Track the single marked target, which counts as both Challenge and Marked for relevant effects.
